verdict.rationale: There are programmatic surfaces beyond the UI. The docs say you can use "Dagster's UI or APIs" to run dbt subsets, the Dagster+ MCP server lets an AI session "access information and take actions" in a deployment, and there is an official dg CLI. Assets and automation are also defined in code. Nothing shows the API covers everything the UI does, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path, so there is no discoverable published API spec. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, a published API reference/spec (OpenAPI or equivalent), evidence that operational UI actions (alerts, asset-check viewing, partition wiping) are reachable via API, independent corroboration.
